coverage_note: These are OSM-mapped object counts, not a guaranteed census of every real-world object in Thailand.
not_equivalent_to_reality: 27 speed cameras does not mean Thailand has only 27 physical cameras; it means 27 OSM objects matched the extractor's speed-camera tag at this snapshot.
No single OSM/Thai open-data source found here provides authoritative nationwide live totals for accident, congestion, road closure, flood and checkpoint states at the same instant.
